# hostname

Print the current Linux network node name.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/hostname
moonx cli/hostname -s
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-s`, `--short` | Print the part before the first dot. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

Reads `/proc/sys/kernel/hostname` in the current namespace. Name changes, resolver-derived aliases and other operating systems are unsupported.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
